title: Wireshark：擷取完整度、過濾器與證據最小化
titleEn: Wireshark: capture completeness, filters and evidence minimization
subcategoryTitle: 網路邊界與可觀測協定
summary: 只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。
summaryEn: Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering.

scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

在交接件中加入「Wireshark：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver capture settings, truncation/loss statistics and shareable pseudonymous packet summaries.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Wireshark：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Wireshark可擷取與解析封包，擷取過濾與顯示過濾作用於不同階段。
knowledge.textEn: Wireshark captures and decodes packets; capture filters and display filters operate at different stages.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。
knowledge.textEn: Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 截斷後可保存的封包位元組近似N×snaplen，另需檔案記錄開銷；被擷取過濾排除的資料不能靠顯示過濾找回。
knowledge.textEn: Truncated packet-byte storage is approximately N×snaplen plus file-record overhead; display filters cannot recover packets excluded at capture.
